rationale: A second Note On for a key already held on the same input port and channel (two keyboards merged onto one input) replaced that key's stored release record, so the first output onset lost its release: two Note Ons were sent and only one Note Off, leaving one note sounding until Stop or Panic. Each new record now keeps the record it displaces (previous), and a Note Off restores it after releasing its own onset, so every output onset gets exactly one release (the latest first).
oracle: Human decision 2026-09-11 for S8: a repeated Note On for a held key must not leave a stuck note. README 195 (the keyboard plays the keys you press) for both onsets sounding; README 805 states for sequenced notes that overlapping notes of the same MIDI pitch still send a corresponding Note Off for each Note On.
